source: Author-created workshop input, not an Azure DevOps export
title: Add a notice section to the demo website
description: Editors need a reusable notice section for a short service update. Start with the existing Razor companion and keep its card section working.
acceptanceCriteria: Use a typed notice model with heading, body, and severity.
Heading is required and limited to 80 characters after trimming.
Body is required and limited to 500 characters after trimming.
Severity allows Info and Warning only; do not silently default invalid values.
Render content using normal Razor encoding, with an accessible heading and a textual severity label.
Add unit tests for valid and invalid input and preserve the existing card-section tests.
constraints: Local synthetic data only; no CMS, Azure, Figma, production, or identity write operation.
No new dependency, persistence layer, generic plugin framework, or Node-service modification.
Use a reviewed specification before implementation and inspect the final full diff.
comments: The design fixture proposes three severity labels. Only Info and Warning are approved in this story; resolve the mismatch before implementation.
